Full summary: Wave 1 T9 + completion: docs shipped (assemble truncation-signature + census caveat, triage by_kind ratify sentence, docs/hooks.md rewritten off the stale pre-1.16 mtime description with the activity-marker hook + read-only audit recipe, CHANGELOG backfilled for tag-only 2.13.0-2.15.0 plus a full 2.16.0 Unreleased section). Full suite green: 1675 passed / 0 failed. Wave 1 of the read-audit remediation plan is implementation-complete on main, untagged.
Decisions: Relaxed the new twining_commits hash validation from 7-40 to 4-40 hex after the existing link_commit integration test caught the inconsistency — git's legal abbreviation minimum is 4 and the store already accepts short hashes via twining_link_commit; rejecting on read what the write path accepts would strand existing links.; Chose NOT to tag/release 2.16.0 in this session — the standing pre-tag adversarial review of the unreleased diff (which has caught majors 7 consecutive times) comes first, and the release also wants the plugin BEHAVIORS.md DECIDE-02 update + bundle rebuild riding the version bump.
Findings: The plugin token-budget CI gate is GREEN at HEAD and measures only plugin/skills + plugin/agents markdown — src/tools description edits never touch it. The stale 'red since 2.6.0' memory note is obsolete (2.15.0's re-baseline fixed it); remediation-plan Assumption 4 discharged.
